_comment: One-click apply / auto-apply gate config (PR A spec item 2, extended by PR B docs/auto-apply-spec.md). fitFloor: minimum fit_score an auto-apply candidate must carry. dailyCap: max auto-apply submissions per day. atsAllow: ATS types auto-apply is permitted to submit through (excludes indeed_easy/linkedin_easy -- classify-only adapters -- and unknown). floors: src/core/salary-floor.js's resolveFloor() inputs, in whole US dollars per year. probeCapPerSource/probeRowCap/reprobeAfterHours: apply-target probe registry budget and cooldown. lockMinutes/pollSeconds: bin/auto-apply.js's own advisory-lock contention poll. unattendedSubmit: read fresh at click time by src/apply/submit-gate.js; enabled:false is the kill switch for every ATS, ats turns each ATS on, dailySubmitCap counts submit clicks. workday.submitMode 'unattended' lets the worker click Workday's Submit after a verified Review page.
